layouts.explanation: I read left to right: inputs, hidden nodes, then output. I select a node or edge in the graph or the labelled menus. Width summarizes sampled edge RMS, not the contribution at a particular input.
I choose a layer and connection to inspect its full sampled edge function: base activation plus Gaussian RBF branch. The diamonds mark Gaussian centers at zero; they are not measured contributions.

I move a slider with the arrow keys to recompute the exported model. Labels show actual activations, and edges show signed contributions at this input. I compare the prediction with the known synthetic target.
I read the loss recorded during training, not a live optimization. The second chart shows the signed relative decrease in rolling-mean loss; a negative value means the loss rose.
